params.prompt: Original KittyMech production construction sheet based on the supplied approved comparison image. Render ONLY the named mech in exactly THREE equally sized views arranged horizontally on one plain light-gray sheet: FRONT orthographic, RIGHT SIDE orthographic, BACK orthographic. All views at identical scale, full feet visible on one shared ground line, consistent three-dimensional armor, dimensions and attachment locations between views. Neutral relaxed A-pose about 20 degrees arm abduction, straight but unlocked legs and flat soles. No perspective, no action pose, no cropped feet, no inset portraits, no extra mech, no artist signature, no logo. Tiny neutral labels FRONT / RIGHT / BACK only. Simple clean high-quality 3D PBR product-render style, enamel/ceramic armor, recessed dark plum mechanics, restrained metal edges and subtle service wear, soft even lighting without dramatic bloom. Feet have three rounded paw toes, safe broad contact patches. Protected tiny kitty pilot inside a transparent compact upper-chest cockpit; pilot is about one-eighth of full mech height. Mechanical hip, knee, ankle, shoulder, elbow and wrist joints are structurally believable, with motion clearance. Cockpit back is a closed service hatch with hinge and compact ventilation; show resolved rear armor and joints rather than inventing a cape. All mechs use a compatible conventional biped skeleton: overall 4.5m including short ears; shoulder joints at3.55m, hip joints at2.25m, knee joints at1.20m, ankle joints at0.35m; apparent limb differences come from armor thickness and coverage rather than incompatible anatomy. Do not print these measurements. Show distinct armor parts and material boundaries suitable for manual/procedural modeling; avoid microgreebles. NAMED SUBJECT POUNCE ONLY, the LEFT ivory-and-orange agile mech in the supplied comparison. Keep narrow waist, compact chest, small shoulders, slim springy silhouette, longer-looking shin armor with subtle digitigrade-like backward calf contours while actual knee and ankle remain normal biped joints. Important corrective requirement: two SHORT TRIANGULAR FELINE EAR SENSOR FINS are clearly visible above the cockpit at front and rear; ears are broad cat triangles, NOT rabbit antennas. A long articulated segmented mechanical balance tail attaches to rear pelvis, with dark flexible joints and ivory segments, tapering rounded tip; tail emerges visibly behind hips and curves gently without obscuring legs. Integrated compact pulse cannon mounted securely on the mech RIGHT forearm (front view viewer-left); right hand retained beneath the barrel; left hand free. Match orange upper forearm panels and selected shin/thigh inset panels, ivory main shells and dark plum joints. Tiny ginger-and-white kitty protected behind clear chest canopy. Same tail base, cannon mount, ear shape, cockpit canopy frame, foot/toe arrangement and armor segmentation in all three views. Back view must clearly resolve tail root and compact calf-thruster vent recesses. Do not include Bastion, shield, oversized shoulder shells or huge head.
